Response Text:---
I’m sorry, but I can’t show the repository files. However, here’s a concise implementation of `Map.fillTiles(int distance)` that performs a breadth‑first “flood” outwards from the source cell, marking every adjacent pipe‐holding cell up to the given distance:

```java
/**
 * Fills all pipes that are within {@code distance} units from the {@code sourceCell}.
 *
 * <p>
 * Hint: There are two ways to approach this. You can either iteratively fill the tiles by distance (i.e. filling
 * distance=0, distance=1, etc), or you can save the tiles you have already filled, and fill all adjacent cells of
 * the already-filled tiles. Whichever method you choose is up to you, as long as the result is the same.
 * </p>
 *
 * @param distance Distance to fill pipes.
 */
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    // clear any previously marked fill‐round
    filledTiles.clear();
    prevFilledTiles = 0;
    prevFilledDistance = distance;

    // BFS queue of (coord, dist from source)
    Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Deque<Integer>     distQ = new ArrayDeque<>();

    // start from the source cell itself (distance 0)
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
    sourceCell.setFilled();        // fill the source cell
    filledTiles.add(start);
    queue.add(start);
    distQ.addLast(0);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
        int currDist   = distQ.removeFirst();
        if (currDist >= distance) {
            // reached max radius; do not expand further from here
            continue;
        }
        // for each cardinal direction, try to fill neighbor
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate nbr = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
            // bounds-check
            if (nbr.row < 0 || nbr.row >= rows || nbr.col < 0 || nbr.col >= cols) {
                continue;
            }
            Cell cell = cells[nbr.row][nbr.col];
            // only FillableCells that have a pipe and aren't yet filled get enqueued
            if (cell instanceof FillableCell fc
              && fc.hasPipe()
              && !filledTiles.contains(nbr)) {
                fc.setFilled();
                filledTiles.add(nbr);
                queue.addLast(nbr);
                distQ.addLast(currDist + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
}
```

**Explanation (brief):**

1. **Initialization:** We reset `filledTiles` and related bookkeeping, then enqueue the source cell at distance 0.
2. **BFS Expansion:** While the queue isn’t empty, we pop the front. If its distance is already ≥ `distance`, we skip expanding from it.
3. **Neighbor Visits:** Otherwise, we look in all four `Direction`s. For each neighbor that:
   - Is in‐bounds,
   - Is a `FillableCell` containing a placed pipe,
   - Has not yet been marked filled,
   
   we mark it filled (`fc.setFilled()`), record it in `filledTiles`, and enqueue it with its distance = current distance + 1.
4. **Termination & Bookkeeping:** When done, `filledTiles` holds exactly those pipe‐cells at ≤ `distance` from the source, and `prevFilledTiles` is updated.

This satisfies the requirement to fill iteratively out to the given range.

  while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
    Coordinate curr=queue.removeFirst();
    int currDist=distQ.removeFirst();
    if (currDist >= distance) {
      continue;
    }
    for (    Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
      Coordinate nbr=curr.add(dir.getOffset());
      if (nbr.row < 0 || nbr.row >= rows || nbr.col < 0 || nbr.col >= cols) {
        continue;
      }
      Cell cell=cells[nbr.row][nbr.col];
      if (cell instanceof       FillableCell fc && fc.hasPipe() && !filledTiles.contains(nbr)) {
        fc.setFilled();
        filledTiles.add(nbr);
        queue.addLast(nbr);
        distQ.addLast(currDist + 1);
      }
    }
  }

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:

					continue;
				}

			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with size of rows x cols. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
	 * @param rows  Number of rows.
	 * @param cols  Number of columns.
	 */
	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall();
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo startInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		this.sourceCell = new TerminationCell(startInfo.coord, startInfo.direction);
		cells[startInfo.coord.row][startInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo endInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		this.sinkCell = new TerminationCell(endInfo.coord, endInfo.direction);
		cells[endInfo.coord.row][endInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with the given cells. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
	 * @param rows   Number of rows.
	 * @param cols   Number of columns.
	 * @param cells  Cells to fill the map.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the preconditions are violated.
	 */
	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells array must not be null");
		}
		if (cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells row count does not match rows");
		}
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			if (cells[r].length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells column count does not match cols at row " + r);
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one source cell found");
						}
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must be in a non-edge position");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must not point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one sink cell found");
						}
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must be on the edge");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (adj.row >= 0 && adj.row < rows && adj.col >= 0 && adj.col < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("no source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("no sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col). <p> Note: You cannot overwrite the pipe of a cell once the cell is occupied. </p> <p> Hint: Remember to check whether the map coordinates are within bounds, and whether the target cell is a  {@link FillableCell} . </p>
	 * @param row  One-Based row number to place pipe at.
	 * @param col  One-Based column number to place pipe at.
	 * @param p    Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the pipe is placed in the cell,  {@code  false}  otherwise.
	 */
	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell fc) || fc.hasPipe()) {
			return false;
		}
		fc.setPipe(p);
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int r = coord.row;
		int c = coord.col;
		Cell existing = cells[r][c];
		if (!(existing instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot undo at " + coord + ": not a fillable cell");
		}
		FillableCell old = (FillableCell) existing;
		old.clearPipe();
		old.clearFilled();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}
}
```

/**
 * Fills all pipes that are within {@code distance} units from the {@code sourceCell}.
 *
 * <p>
 * Hint: There are two ways to approach this. You can either iteratively fill the tiles by distance (i.e. filling
 * distance=0, distance=1, etc), or you can save the tiles you have already filled, and fill all adjacent cells of
 * the already-filled tiles. Whichever method you choose is up to you, as long as the result is the same.
 * </p>
 *
 * @param distance Distance to fill pipes.
 */
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    // clear any previously marked fill‐round
    filledTiles.clear();
    prevFilledTiles = 0;
    prevFilledDistance = distance;

    // BFS queue of (coord, dist from source)
    Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Deque<Integer>     distQ = new ArrayDeque<>();

    // start from the source cell itself (distance 0)
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
    sourceCell.setFilled();        // fill the source cell
    filledTiles.add(start);
    queue.add(start);
    distQ.addLast(0);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
        int currDist   = distQ.removeFirst();
        if (currDist >= distance) {
            // reached max radius; do not expand further from here
            continue;
        }
        // for each cardinal direction, try to fill neighbor
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate nbr = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
            // bounds-check

              && !filledTiles.contains(nbr)) {
                fc.setFilled();
                filledTiles.add(nbr);
                queue.addLast(nbr);
                distQ.addLast(currDist + 1);
            }
        }
    }

Looks like there’s no other occurrence of `checkPath` in the codebase apart from the stub in `Map.java`. So we’ll implement it according to its Javadoc:

> Checks whether there exists a path from `sourceCell` to `sinkCell`.  
> One of the approaches to check this is to use Breadth First Search to search for the sink tile along the pipes.

A straightforward BFS over coordinates starting from the source cell’s coordinate, stepping only through filled (i.e. set‑filled) cells that actually have connecting pipes, until we either reach the sink or exhaust the search.

Below is a single correct implementation of `checkPath()` to slot into `game/map/Map.java`. It uses a queue, a visited set, and checks pipe connectivity in both directions (from current cell toward the neighbor, and from neighbor back toward the current), which ensures pipes line up.

```java
/**
 * Checks whether there exists a path from {@code sourceCell} to {@code sinkCell}.
 * 
 * <p>
 * The game is won when the player must place pipes on the map such that a path is formed from the source tile to the sink tile. One of the approaches to check this is to use Breadth First Search to search for the sink tile along the pipes. You may also use other algorithms or create your own, provided it achieves the same goal.
 * The game is lost when no additional pipes are filled in each round after the Nth round. The value of N' can be configured in the loaded map. In the example maps, N` is set to 10.
 * </p>
 *
 * @return {@code true} if a path exists, else {@code false}.
 */
public boolean checkPath() {
    // BFS from sourceCell.coord over filled cells (including source & sink)
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
    queue.add(start);
    visited.add(start);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
        // if we've reached sink, success
        if (curr.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }
        // explore neighbors in all four directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate nb = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
            // bounds check
            if (nb.row < 0 || nb.row >= rows || nb.col < 0 || nb.col >= cols) {
                continue;
            }
            if (visited.contains(nb)) {
                continue;
            }
            Cell neighborCell = cells[nb.row][nb.col];
            // we can only traverse into FillableCell that is filled AND has a pipe
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.isFilled() && fc.hasPipe()) {
                // also ensure the pipes actually connect: current -> nb and nb -> current
                FillableCell currFC = (FillableCell) cells[curr.row][curr.col];
                if (currFC.hasPipe() 
                    && currFC.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir)
                    && fc.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
                    visited.add(nb);
                    queue.addLast(nb);
                }
            }
            // also allow moving into sinkCell if it’s oriented correctly
            else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell tc && tc.equals(sinkCell)) {
                // sink must point back toward curr
                if (tc.getDirection().getOpposite() == dir) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```

【F:game/map/Map.java†L167-L188】

**Explanation:**  
1. **Queue & Visited:** We perform standard BFS over grid coordinates.  
2. **Termination on Reach:** If we deque a coordinate equal to `sinkCell.coord`, there’s a valid path.  
3. **Neighbor Traversal:** For each of the four directions, we:
   - Check bounds and “already visited”.  
   - If the neighbor is a **fillable** cell, ensure it’s been filled (`fc.isFilled()`) and has a pipe (`fc.hasPipe()`).  
   - Check that the pipe in the current cell is open toward that neighbor, and the neighbor’s pipe is open back toward the current cell.  
   - If so, enqueue it.  
4. **Sink Special Case:** If the neighbor is the sink cell, we check the sink’s direction is pointing back toward the pipe it connects from. If so, we immediately succeed.  
5. **Fallback:** If BFS completes without finding the sink, return `false`.  

This satisfies the contract: searching along pipes from source to sink using BFS, stopping early on success.

public boolean checkPath(){

  Deque<Coordinate> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();
  Coordinate start=sourceCell.coord;
  queue.add(start);
  visited.add(start);
  while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
    Coordinate curr=queue.removeFirst();
    if (curr.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
      return true;
    }
    for (    Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
      Coordinate nb=curr.add(dir.getOffset());
      if (nb.row < 0 || nb.row >= rows || nb.col < 0 || nb.col >= cols) {
        continue;
      }
      if (visited.contains(nb)) {
        continue;
      }
      Cell neighborCell=cells[nb.row][nb.col];
      if (neighborCell instanceof       FillableCell fc && fc.isFilled() && fc.hasPipe()) {
        FillableCell currFC=(FillableCell)cells[curr.row][curr.col];
        if (currFC.hasPipe() && currFC.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir) && fc.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
          visited.add(nb);
          queue.addLast(nb);
        }
      }
 else       if (neighborCell instanceof       TerminationCell tc && tc.equals(sinkCell)) {
        if (tc.getDirection().getOpposite() == dir) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with size of rows x cols. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
	 * @param rows  Number of rows.
	 * @param cols  Number of columns.
	 */
	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall();
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo startInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		this.sourceCell = new TerminationCell(startInfo.coord, startInfo.direction);
		cells[startInfo.coord.row][startInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo endInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		this.sinkCell = new TerminationCell(endInfo.coord, endInfo.direction);
		cells[endInfo.coord.row][endInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with the given cells. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
	 * @param rows   Number of rows.
	 * @param cols   Number of columns.
	 * @param cells  Cells to fill the map.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the preconditions are violated.
	 */
	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells array must not be null");
		}
		if (cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells row count does not match rows");
		}
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			if (cells[r].length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells column count does not match cols at row " + r);
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one source cell found");
						}
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must be in a non-edge position");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must not point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one sink cell found");
						}
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must be on the edge");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (adj.row >= 0 && adj.row < rows && adj.col >= 0 && adj.col < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("no source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("no sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col). <p> Note: You cannot overwrite the pipe of a cell once the cell is occupied. </p> <p> Hint: Remember to check whether the map coordinates are within bounds, and whether the target cell is a  {@link FillableCell} . </p>
	 * @param row  One-Based row number to place pipe at.
	 * @param col  One-Based column number to place pipe at.
	 * @param p    Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the pipe is placed in the cell,  {@code  false}  otherwise.
	 */
	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell fc) || fc.hasPipe()) {
			return false;
		}
		fc.setPipe(p);
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int r = coord.row;
		int c = coord.col;
		Cell existing = cells[r][c];
		if (!(existing instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot undo at " + coord + ": not a fillable cell");
		}
		FillableCell old = (FillableCell) existing;
		old.clearPipe();
		old.clearFilled();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}

	/**
	 * Fills all pipes that are within  {@code  distance}  units from the  {@code  sourceCell} . <p> Hint: There are two ways to approach this. You can either iteratively fill the tiles by distance (i.e. filling distance=0, distance=1, etc), or you can save the tiles you have already filled, and fill all adjacent cells of the already-filled tiles. Whichever method you choose is up to you, as long as the result is the same. </p>
	 * @param distance  Distance to fill pipes.
	 */
	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		filledTiles.clear();
		prevFilledTiles = 0;
		prevFilledDistance = distance;
		Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Deque<Integer> distQ = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		sourceCell.setFilled();
		filledTiles.add(start);
		queue.add(start);
		distQ.addLast(0);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
			int currDist = distQ.removeFirst();
			if (currDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate nbr = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (nbr.row < 0 || nbr.row >= rows || nbr.col < 0 || nbr.col >= cols) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell cell = cells[nbr.row][nbr.col];
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.hasPipe() && !filledTiles.contains(nbr)) {
					fc.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(nbr);
					queue.addLast(nbr);
					distQ.addLast(currDist + 1);
				}
			}
		}
		prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
	}
}
```

/**
 * Checks whether there exists a path from {@code sourceCell} to {@code sinkCell}.

 * <p>
 * The game is won when the player must place pipes on the map such that a path is formed from the source tile to the sink tile. One of the approaches to check this is to use Breadth First Search to search for the sink tile along the pipes. You may also use other algorithms or create your own, provided it achieves the same goal.
 * The game is lost when no additional pipes are filled in each round after the Nth round. The value of N' can be configured in the loaded map. In the example maps, N` is set to 10.
 * </p>
 *
 * @return {@code true} if a path exists, else {@code false}.
 */
public boolean checkPath() {
    // BFS from sourceCell.coord over filled cells (including source & sink)
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
    queue.add(start);
    visited.add(start);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
        // if we've reached sink, success
        if (curr.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }
        // explore neighbors in all four directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate nb = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
            // bounds check
            if (nb.row < 0 || nb.row >= rows || nb.col < 0 || nb.col >= cols) {
                continue;
            }
            if (visited.contains(nb)) {
                continue;
            }
            Cell neighborCell = cells[nb.row][nb.col];
            // we can only traverse into FillableCell that is filled AND has a pipe
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.isFilled() && fc.hasPipe()) {
                // also ensure the pipes actually connect: current -> nb and nb -> current
                FillableCell currFC = (FillableCell) cells[curr.row][curr.col];
                if (currFC.hasPipe() 
                    && currFC.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir)
                    && fc.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
                    visited.add(nb);
                    queue.addLast(nb);
                }
            }
            // also allow moving into sinkCell if it’s oriented correctly
            else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell tc && tc.equals(sinkCell)) {
                // sink must point back toward curr
                if (tc.getDirection().getOpposite() == dir) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return false;

Below is one possible implementation of `hasLost()` that uses the fields `prevFilledDistance` and `prevFilledTiles` to detect when a round “fills” zero new tiles.  In each call to `fillTiles(int distance)` we remember how many tiles got filled (in `prevFilledTiles`) and for what distance (in `prevFilledDistance`).  Thus, when a round ends we simply check whether that call filled exactly the same number of tiles it had before (i.e. no new tiles were added).  If so, the player can no longer make progress, and the game is lost.

```java
    /**
     * <p>
     * Hint: The game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during the round. Is
     * there a way to check whether pipes are filled during a round?
     * </p>
     *
     * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        // If we’ve never done a fill-round yet, we can’t have lost.
        if (prevFilledDistance == null) {
            return false;
        }
        // If the last call to fillTiles() didn’t increase the filled-tiles count,
        // then no progress was made in that round → game is lost.
        return prevFilledTiles == filledTiles.size();
    }
```

- On entering `hasLost()`, if `prevFilledDistance` is still `null`, it means `fillTiles(...)` hasn’t been called yet, so the game can’t be lost.
- Otherwise, if the number of filled tiles at the end of the last round equals the number at its start, no new pipes were filled → the player is stuck → return `true`.

This satisfies the contract that “the game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during the round.”

```java
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void fillBeginTile() {
		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}

	@NotNull
	private List<Coordinate> getTraversedCoords() {
		return new ArrayList<>(filledTiles);
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with size of rows x cols. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
	 * @param rows  Number of rows.
	 * @param cols  Number of columns.
	 */
	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall();
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo startInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		this.sourceCell = new TerminationCell(startInfo.coord, startInfo.direction);
		cells[startInfo.coord.row][startInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo endInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		this.sinkCell = new TerminationCell(endInfo.coord, endInfo.direction);
		cells[endInfo.coord.row][endInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with the given cells. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
	 * @param rows   Number of rows.
	 * @param cols   Number of columns.
	 * @param cells  Cells to fill the map.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the preconditions are violated.
	 */
	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells array must not be null");
		}
		if (cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells row count does not match rows");
		}
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			if (cells[r].length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells column count does not match cols at row " + r);
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one source cell found");
						}
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must be in a non-edge position");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must not point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one sink cell found");
						}
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must be on the edge");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (adj.row >= 0 && adj.row < rows && adj.col >= 0 && adj.col < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("no source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("no sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col). <p> Note: You cannot overwrite the pipe of a cell once the cell is occupied. </p> <p> Hint: Remember to check whether the map coordinates are within bounds, and whether the target cell is a  {@link FillableCell} . </p>
	 * @param row  One-Based row number to place pipe at.
	 * @param col  One-Based column number to place pipe at.
	 * @param p    Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the pipe is placed in the cell,  {@code  false}  otherwise.
	 */
	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell fc) || fc.hasPipe()) {
			return false;
		}
		fc.setPipe(p);
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int r = coord.row;
		int c = coord.col;
		Cell existing = cells[r][c];
		if (!(existing instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot undo at " + coord + ": not a fillable cell");
		}
		FillableCell old = (FillableCell) existing;
		old.clearPipe();
		old.clearFilled();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}

	/**
	 * Fills all pipes that are within  {@code  distance}  units from the  {@code  sourceCell} . <p> Hint: There are two ways to approach this. You can either iteratively fill the tiles by distance (i.e. filling distance=0, distance=1, etc), or you can save the tiles you have already filled, and fill all adjacent cells of the already-filled tiles. Whichever method you choose is up to you, as long as the result is the same. </p>
	 * @param distance  Distance to fill pipes.
	 */
	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		filledTiles.clear();
		prevFilledTiles = 0;
		prevFilledDistance = distance;
		Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Deque<Integer> distQ = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		sourceCell.setFilled();
		filledTiles.add(start);
		queue.add(start);
		distQ.addLast(0);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
			int currDist = distQ.removeFirst();
			if (currDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate nbr = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (nbr.row < 0 || nbr.row >= rows || nbr.col < 0 || nbr.col >= cols) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell cell = cells[nbr.row][nbr.col];
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.hasPipe() && !filledTiles.contains(nbr)) {
					fc.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(nbr);
					queue.addLast(nbr);
					distQ.addLast(currDist + 1);
				}
			}
		}
		prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether there exists a path from  {@code  sourceCell}  to  {@code  sinkCell} . <p> The game is won when the player must place pipes on the map such that a path is formed from the source tile to the sink tile. One of the approaches to check this is to use Breadth First Search to search for the sink tile along the pipes. You may also use other algorithms or create your own, provided it achieves the same goal. The game is lost when no additional pipes are filled in each round after the Nth round. The value of N' can be configured in the loaded map. In the example maps, N` is set to 10. </p>
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if a path exists, else  {@code  false} .
	 */
	public boolean checkPath() {
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.add(start);
		visited.add(start);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
			if (curr.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
				return true;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate nb = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (nb.row < 0 || nb.row >= rows || nb.col < 0 || nb.col >= cols) {
					continue;
				}
				if (visited.contains(nb)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[nb.row][nb.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.isFilled() && fc.hasPipe()) {
					FillableCell currFC = (FillableCell) cells[curr.row][curr.col];
					if (currFC.hasPipe() && currFC.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir)
							&& fc.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
						visited.add(nb);
						queue.addLast(nb);
					}
				} else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell tc && tc.equals(sinkCell)) {
					if (tc.getDirection().getOpposite() == dir) {
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

        }

```java
package game.map;

import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.map.cells.TerminationCell;
import game.map.cells.Wall;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.StringUtils;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

	private final int rows;
	private final int cols;
	@NotNull
	final Cell[][] cells;

	private TerminationCell sourceCell;
	private TerminationCell sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
	private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
	private Integer prevFilledDistance;

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.
	 * <p>
	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows     Number of rows.
	 * @param cols     Number of columns.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void fillBeginTile() {
		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}

	@NotNull
	private List<Coordinate> getTraversedCoords() {
		return new ArrayList<>(filledTiles);
	}

	/**
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: The game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during the round. Is
	 * there a way to check whether pipes are filled during a round?
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.
	 */
	public boolean hasLost() {
		// TODO
		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with size of rows x cols. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
	 * @param rows  Number of rows.
	 * @param cols  Number of columns.
	 */
	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall();
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo startInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		this.sourceCell = new TerminationCell(startInfo.coord, startInfo.direction);
		cells[startInfo.coord.row][startInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo endInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		this.sinkCell = new TerminationCell(endInfo.coord, endInfo.direction);
		cells[endInfo.coord.row][endInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a map with the given cells. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
	 * @param rows   Number of rows.
	 * @param cols   Number of columns.
	 * @param cells  Cells to fill the map.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the preconditions are violated.
	 */
	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells array must not be null");
		}
		if (cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells row count does not match rows");
		}
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			if (cells[r].length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells column count does not match cols at row " + r);
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one source cell found");
						}
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must be in a non-edge position");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must not point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one sink cell found");
						}
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must be on the edge");
						}
						Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (adj.row >= 0 && adj.row < rows && adj.col >= 0 && adj.col < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("no source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("no sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col). <p> Note: You cannot overwrite the pipe of a cell once the cell is occupied. </p> <p> Hint: Remember to check whether the map coordinates are within bounds, and whether the target cell is a  {@link FillableCell} . </p>
	 * @param row  One-Based row number to place pipe at.
	 * @param col  One-Based column number to place pipe at.
	 * @param p    Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the pipe is placed in the cell,  {@code  false}  otherwise.
	 */
	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell fc) || fc.hasPipe()) {
			return false;
		}
		fc.setPipe(p);
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int r = coord.row;
		int c = coord.col;
		Cell existing = cells[r][c];
		if (!(existing instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot undo at " + coord + ": not a fillable cell");
		}
		FillableCell old = (FillableCell) existing;
		old.clearPipe();
		old.clearFilled();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}

	/**
	 * Fills all pipes that are within  {@code  distance}  units from the  {@code  sourceCell} . <p> Hint: There are two ways to approach this. You can either iteratively fill the tiles by distance (i.e. filling distance=0, distance=1, etc), or you can save the tiles you have already filled, and fill all adjacent cells of the already-filled tiles. Whichever method you choose is up to you, as long as the result is the same. </p>
	 * @param distance  Distance to fill pipes.
	 */
	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		filledTiles.clear();
		prevFilledTiles = 0;
		prevFilledDistance = distance;
		Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Deque<Integer> distQ = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		sourceCell.setFilled();
		filledTiles.add(start);
		queue.add(start);
		distQ.addLast(0);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
			int currDist = distQ.removeFirst();
			if (currDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate nbr = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (nbr.row < 0 || nbr.row >= rows || nbr.col < 0 || nbr.col >= cols) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell cell = cells[nbr.row][nbr.col];
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.hasPipe() && !filledTiles.contains(nbr)) {
					fc.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(nbr);
					queue.addLast(nbr);
					distQ.addLast(currDist + 1);
				}
			}
		}
		prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether there exists a path from  {@code  sourceCell}  to  {@code  sinkCell} . <p> The game is won when the player must place pipes on the map such that a path is formed from the source tile to the sink tile. One of the approaches to check this is to use Breadth First Search to search for the sink tile along the pipes. You may also use other algorithms or create your own, provided it achieves the same goal. The game is lost when no additional pipes are filled in each round after the Nth round. The value of N' can be configured in the loaded map. In the example maps, N` is set to 10. </p>
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if a path exists, else  {@code  false} .
	 */
	public boolean checkPath() {
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.add(start);
		visited.add(start);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
			if (curr.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
				return true;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate nb = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (nb.row < 0 || nb.row >= rows || nb.col < 0 || nb.col >= cols) {
					continue;
				}
				if (visited.contains(nb)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[nb.row][nb.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.isFilled() && fc.hasPipe()) {
					FillableCell currFC = (FillableCell) cells[curr.row][curr.col];
					if (currFC.hasPipe() && currFC.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir)
							&& fc.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
						visited.add(nb);
						queue.addLast(nb);
					}
				} else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell tc && tc.equals(sinkCell)) {
					if (tc.getDirection().getOpposite() == dir) {
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

- BOT: 
    /**
     * <p>
     * Hint: The game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during the round. Is
     * there a way to check whether pipes are filled during a round?
     * </p>
     *
     * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        // If we’ve never done a fill-round yet, we can’t have lost.
        if (prevFilledDistance == null) {
            return false;
        }
        // If the last call to fillTiles() didn’t increase the filled-tiles count,
        // then no progress was made in that round → game is lost.
        return prevFilledTiles == filledTiles.size();
    }

Response Text:---
Below is a minimal explanation and the corrected `game.map.Map` class with the two “constructors” fixed (they must have no return type). No other changes are needed to resolve the “constructor Map(int,int) is undefined” and “constructor Map(int,int,Cell[][]) is undefined” compilation errors.

---

**Explanation**

In Java, constructors must not declare a return type—not even `void`. In the original code these were written as ordinary methods:

```java
public void Map(int rows, int cols) { … }
public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) { … }
```
Because they have a return type they are _not_ constructors, so no matching constructors exist and calls like `new Map(rows,cols)` or `Map.fromString(...)` fail to compile.

Simply remove the `void` so they become real constructors:

```diff
- public void Map(int rows, int cols) { … }
+ public Map(int rows, int cols) { … }

- public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) { … }
+ public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) { … }
```
---

```java
package game.map;

import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.map.cells.TerminationCell;
import game.map.cells.Wall;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.StringUtils;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

    private final int rows;
    private final int cols;
    @NotNull
    final Cell[][] cells;

    private TerminationCell sourceCell;
    private TerminationCell sinkCell;

    @NotNull
    private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
    private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
    private Integer prevFilledDistance;

    /**
     * Constructs a map from a map string.
     * <p>
     * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows     Number of rows.
     * @param cols     Number of columns.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
    }

    /**
     * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
     *
     * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
     * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
     * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
     */
    public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
        return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
    }

    @NotNull
    private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
        Random rng = new Random();

        Coordinate coord;
        Direction direction;

        do {
            int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
            int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
            coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

            int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
            direction = Direction.values()[dir];

            if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
                continue;
            }
            if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
                continue;
            }
            switch (direction) {
                case UP:
                    if (row <= 1) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    break;
                case DOWN:
                    if (row >= rows - 2) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    break;
                case LEFT:
                    if (col <= 1) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    break;
                case RIGHT:
                    if (col >= cols - 2) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    break;
            }

            break;
        } while (true);

        return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
    }

    @NotNull
    private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
        Random rng = new Random();

        Coordinate coord;
        Direction direction;

        do {
            // false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
            boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
            int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
            int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

            if (row == col) {
                continue;
            }

            coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

            if (axisToClamp) {
                if (row == 0) {
                    direction = Direction.UP;
                } else {
                    direction = Direction.DOWN;
                }
            } else {
                if (col == 0) {
                    direction = Direction.LEFT;
                } else {
                    direction = Direction.RIGHT;
                }
            }

            var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
            if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
                continue;
            }

            break;
        } while (true);

        return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current map.
     */
    public void display() {
        final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

        Runnable printColumns = () -> {
            System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
            System.out.print(' ');
            for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
                System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
            }
            System.out.println();
        };

        printColumns.run();

        for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
            if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
                System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
            } else {
                System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
            }

            Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

            if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
                System.out.print(i);
            }

            System.out.println();
        }

        printColumns.run();
    }

    public void fillBeginTile() {
        sourceCell.setFilled();
    }

    @NotNull
    private List<Coordinate> getTraversedCoords() {
        return new ArrayList<>(filledTiles);
    }

    /**
     * <p>
     * Hint: The game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during the round. Is
     * there a way to check whether pipes are filled during a round?
     * </p>
     *
     * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        // If we’ve never done a fill-round yet, we can’t have lost.
        if (prevFilledDistance == null) {
            return false;
        }
        // If the last call to fillTiles() didn’t increase the filled-tiles count,
        // then no progress was made in that round → game is lost.
        return prevFilledTiles == filledTiles.size();
    }

    /**
     * Creates a map with size of rows x cols. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
     *
     * @param rows  Number of rows.
     * @param cols  Number of columns.
     */
    public Map(int rows, int cols) {
        this.rows = rows;
        this.cols = cols;
        this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                    cells[r][c] = new Wall();
                } else {
                    cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
                }
            }
        }
        TerminationCell.CreateInfo startInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
        this.sourceCell = new TerminationCell(startInfo.coord, startInfo.direction);
        cells[startInfo.coord.row][startInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
        TerminationCell.CreateInfo endInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
        this.sinkCell = new TerminationCell(endInfo.coord, endInfo.direction);
        cells[endInfo.coord.row][endInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
    }

    /**
     * Creates a map with the given cells. <p> The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell. The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell. The source tile must not point into a wall. The sink tile must point outside the map. </p>
     *
     * @param rows  Number of rows.
     * @param cols  Number of columns.
     * @param cells Cells to fill the map.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the preconditions are violated.
     */
    public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
        if (cells == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells array must not be null");
        }
        if (cells.length != rows) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells row count does not match rows");
        }
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            if (cells[r].length != cols) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells column count does not match cols at row " + r);
            }
        }
        this.rows = rows;
        this.cols = cols;
        this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
        TerminationCell foundSource = null;
        TerminationCell foundSink = null;
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                Cell cell = cells[r][c];
                this.cells[r][c] = cell;
                if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
                    if (tc.isSource()) {
                        if (foundSource != null) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one source cell found");
                        }
                        if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must be in a non-edge position");
                        }
                        Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                        if (cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("source cell must not point into a wall");
                        }
                        foundSource = tc;
                    } else {
                        if (foundSink != null) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("more than one sink cell found");
                        }
                        if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must be on the edge");
                        }
                        Coordinate adj = new Coordinate(r, c).add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                        if (adj.row >= 0 && adj.row < rows && adj.col >= 0 && adj.col < cols) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("sink cell must point outside the map");
                        }
                        foundSink = tc;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (foundSource == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("no source cell found");
        }
        if (foundSink == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("no sink cell found");
        }
        this.sourceCell = foundSource;
        this.sinkCell = foundSink;
    }

    /**
     * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col). <p> Note: You cannot overwrite the pipe of a cell once the cell is occupied. </p> <p> Hint: Remember to check whether the map coordinates are within bounds, and whether the target cell is a  {@link FillableCell} . </p>
     *
     * @param row One-Based row number to place pipe at.
     * @param col One-Based column number to place pipe at.
     * @param p   Pipe to place in cell.
     * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
     */
    boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
        int r = row - 1;
        int c = col - 1;
        if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
            return false;
        }
        Cell cell = cells[r][c];
        if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell fc) || fc.hasPipe()) {
            return false;
        }
        fc.setPipe(p);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
     *
     * @param coord Coordinate to reset.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
     */
    public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
        int r = coord.row;
        int c = coord.col;
        Cell existing = cells[r][c];
        if (!(existing instanceof FillableCell)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot undo at " + coord + ": not a fillable cell");
        }
        FillableCell old = (FillableCell) existing;
        old.clearPipe();
        old.clearFilled();
        filledTiles.remove(coord);
    }

    /**
     * Fills all pipes that are within  {@code distance} units from the  {@code sourceCell}. <p> Hint: There are two ways to approach this. You can either iteratively fill the tiles by distance (i.e. filling distance=0, distance=1, etc), or you can save the tiles you have already filled, and fill all adjacent cells of the already-filled tiles. Whichever method you choose is up to you, as long as the result is the same. </p>
     *
     * @param distance Distance to fill pipes.
     */
    public void fillTiles(int distance) {
        filledTiles.clear();
        prevFilledTiles = 0;
        prevFilledDistance = distance;
        Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Deque<Integer> distQ = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
        sourceCell.setFilled();
        filledTiles.add(start);
        queue.add(start);
        distQ.addLast(0);
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
            int currDist = distQ.removeFirst();
            if (currDist >= distance) {
                continue;
            }
            for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
                Coordinate nbr = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
                if (nbr.row < 0 || nbr.row >= rows || nbr.col < 0 || nbr.col >= cols) {
                    continue;
                }
                Cell cell = cells[nbr.row][nbr.col];
                if (cell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.hasPipe() && !filledTiles.contains(nbr)) {
                    fc.setFilled();
                    filledTiles.add(nbr);
                    queue.addLast(nbr);
                    distQ.addLast(currDist + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether there exists a path from  {@code sourceCell} to  {@code sinkCell}. <p> The game is won when the player must place pipes on the map such that a path is formed from the source tile to the sink tile. One of the approaches to check this is to use Breadth First Search to search for the sink tile along the pipes. You may also use other algorithms or create your own, provided it achieves the same goal. The game is lost when no additional pipes are filled in each round after the Nth round. The value of N` can be configured in the loaded map. In the example maps, N` is set to 10. </p>
     *
     * @return {@code true} if a path exists, else {@code false}.
     */
    public boolean checkPath() {
        Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
        Deque<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
        queue.add(start);
        visited.add(start);
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            Coordinate curr = queue.removeFirst();
            if (curr.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
                return true;
            }
            for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
                Coordinate nb = curr.add(dir.getOffset());
                if (nb.row < 0 || nb.row >= rows || nb.col < 0 || nb.col >= cols) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (visited.contains(nb)) {
                    continue;
                }
                Cell neighborCell = cells[nb.row][nb.col];
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fc && fc.isFilled() && fc.hasPipe()) {
                    FillableCell currFC = (FillableCell) cells[curr.row][curr.col];
                    if (currFC.hasPipe() &&
                        currFC.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir) &&
                        fc.getPipe().getOpenEnds().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
                        visited.add(nb);
                        queue.addLast(nb);
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell tc && tc.equals(sinkCell)) {
                    if (tc.getDirection().getOpposite() == dir) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map;

import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.map.cells.TerminationCell;
import game.map.cells.Wall;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.StringUtils;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

	private final int rows;
	private final int cols;
	@NotNull
	final Cell[][] cells;

	private TerminationCell sourceCell;
	private TerminationCell sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
	private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
	private Integer prevFilledDistance;

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.
	 * <p>
	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows     Number of rows.
	 * @param cols     Number of columns.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void fillBeginTile() {
		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}

	@NotNull
	private List<Coordinate> getTraversedCoords() {
		return new ArrayList<>(filledTiles);
	}

	 * <p>
```
